metadata.title: शेर के साथ आदिवासी भी बचाईए | Tribal Livelihoods within Udanti Sita Nadi Wildlife Sanctuary
metadata.description: Udanti Sita Nadi Wildlife Sanctuary in Chhattisgarh is renowned for its rich biodiversity and is also home to tribal communities. However, due to its status as a reserve forest, development projects require clearance from the Environment and Forest Department, leading to a lack of basic amenities such as roads and drinking water in many villages. The policy primarily focuses on wildlife conservation rather than addressing the needs of the tribal population. As a result, for the tribals living in this sanctuary, the National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA) and collection of forest produce are their primary means of survival.
